responsibility: Implements the compact access-tree data structure used by modref analysis to summarize memory loads, stores, and kills. It defines equality, containment, update, merge, collapse, and search behavior for modref_access_node and related templated base/ref tree nodes, includes selftests for insertion/merging, and provides the GGC/PCH marking hooks for these templates. This file is the data-structure implementation layer beneath the actual modref analysis in ipa-modref.cc.
same_name_distinction: Implements the modref access-tree container itself: access-node equality/containment/merge/update behavior, tree insertion/search/collapse logic, selftests, and GGC/PCH support code. Unlike gcc/ipa-modref-tree.h, it is the concrete data-structure implementation rather than the template/type declarations and public operations contract.
